Chuppi kaam mein shanti hai.
Jitni sakht jung, utni meethi jeet.
Jo kabhi mistake nahi karta—wo kuch naya try hi nahi karta.
Shuru karne ki himmat rakho.
Himmat—darte hue bhi kaam ka hunar.
Grit shakti hai.
Himmat aur aqal saath chalte.
Himmat unchi hai.
Khamoshi ko aagyanta, shaanti ko swikaar, aur daayaluat ko kamzori mat samjho.
Khamoshi sabse heavy sach sambhal sakti.
Bahadur woh nahi jo darta nahi—jo us fear ko conquer kare.
Grit yeh yaqeen hai ki jaari rakh sakte.
Dil ka quit na karna—courage.
Grit luck nahi; kaam hai.
Apne dushmanon ka saamna karo.
Khamoshi spashtata lati hai.
Success aakhri nahi, failure maut nahi: aage badhne ki himmat hi maine rakhti hai.
Shak dushman nahi; darr dushman hai.
